conventions: records: one per message, in inbox order (R01 to R12 = message 1 to 12, oldest first). Use items to avoid counting one invoice number twice.
money: strings with two decimals as printed on the document; null where the document states none. Credit note amounts are the credit values as printed (positive).
dates: ISO YYYY-MM-DD; received is the email timestamp as exported.
relation says how a record relates to another document; version_status says which version of a document number is latest as shown in the inbox.
flags use the run vocabulary and record only what the inbox shows. PAID, REFUNDED, POVAR and NOPO need the bank feed or PO list, which are reconciler inputs, so none is set here.
items: one row per distinct invoice, credit note or subject; these are the ST lines sent with the handoff. amounts_from names the record whose amounts stand for that item.
not_checked_by_extractor: bank feed: whether anything is already paid, and whether CN-012 was refunded
PO list: PO amounts, variance against PO, missing POs
supplier master: bank details on file, domain on file, currency of account. LOOKALIKE is judged against the other Northfield messages in this inbox and should be confirmed against the master.
checks_done: net + VAT = gross and VAT = 20% of net on every GBP invoice and on CN-012, including both versions of INV-000491
INV-000491 correction: 2,000 sheets at 82.75 per thousand = 165.50, as the supplier says
every invoice message arrived between 2026-09-02 and 2026-09-22, before the month-end
